preconditions.description: The number of stewards n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each steward's strength a_i is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for a_i in a if any(a_j < a_i for a_j in a) and any(a_j > a_i for a_j in a))
postconditions.description: The output is the number of stewards whose strength is strictly greater than at least one steward and strictly less than at least one steward.
